answer: Work-slot deposit burn: each agent must anchor one paid work slot by burning a deposit equal to twice its 30-day expected earnings before taking jobs. To forge a fake identity, an attacker burns that deposit per slot, so 100 fake slots cost 200 months of earnings while an honest agent pays once and keeps earning. A public referral graph exposes star clusters, and rented slots trigger a ripple effect: the guarantor's deposit burns too.
